earthRally_window.title: Earth Rally: menu
earthRally_window.desc: Opens or closes the Earth Rally menu (rallies, stages, settings).

earthRally_backOnRoad.title: Earth Rally: back on the road
earthRally_backOnRoad.desc: Puts the car back on the stage's road where it got to, facing on along the stage (+10 s on a timed stage with the reset penalty on). In a full rally it is the rally's recovery: free in Casual; in Realistic it asks, then ends the stage under Super Rally.

earthRally_flipUpright.title: Earth Rally: flip upright
earthRally_flipUpright.desc: Turns the car back onto its wheels where it is (no penalty).

earthRally_rallyRecover.title: Earth Rally: full rally recovery
earthRally_rallyRecover.desc: The full rally's recovery, for a pad (D-pad right by default, where the game's own reset sits: it is off during a rally). Does nothing outside a full rally.

earthRally_rallySelect.title: Earth Rally: rally menu (pad)
earthRally_rallySelect.desc: During a full rally: opens or closes the rally menu, and goes back to it from the map (Select on a pad by default, where the map sits). Does nothing outside a full rally.

earthRally_cardOk.title: Earth Rally: card, select
earthRally_cardOk.desc: On an Earth Rally card (Load the stage?, Recover?, the stage's finish card): presses the picked button.

earthRally_cardBack.title: Earth Rally: card, back
earthRally_cardBack.desc: On an Earth Rally card: Not yet / Keep going / Close.

earthRally_cardPrev.title: Earth Rally: card, previous button
earthRally_cardPrev.desc: On an Earth Rally card: picks the button before.

earthRally_cardNext.title: Earth Rally: card, next button
earthRally_cardNext.desc: On an Earth Rally card: picks the button after.

earthRally_cardStickX.onChange: if earthRally_main then earthRally_main.cardStick('x', VALUE, 'DEVICENAME') end
earthRally_cardStickX.title: Earth Rally: card, pick left / right
earthRally_cardStickX.desc: On an Earth Rally card: the stick picks along its buttons.

earthRally_cardStickY.onChange: if earthRally_main then earthRally_main.cardStick('y', VALUE, 'DEVICENAME') end
earthRally_cardStickY.title: Earth Rally: card, pick up / down
earthRally_cardStickY.desc: On an Earth Rally card: the stick picks along its buttons.
